Theorem
[Path-integrated Harnack inequality] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0431 ↗ thm:chow-ii-li-yau-estimate 1. appe:1.19\group Heat Kernel Estimates

For $0<t_1<t_2$, \[ \frac{u(x_2,t_2)}{u(x_1,t_1)}\ge \left(\frac{t_2}{t_1}\right)^{-\alpha n/2} \exp \left[-\frac{\alpha d(x_1,x_2)^2}{4(t_2-t_1)} -\frac{n\alpha k}{2(\alpha -1)}(t_2-t_1)\right]. \] For $k=0$ and a fundamental solution, letting $t_1\downarrow 0$ gives the Gaussian lower bound $(4\pi t)^{-n/2}e^{-d(x,y)^2/(4t)}$.
